punchline: Two days after the Northridge earthquake, one driver in the jam was cursing California while the man behind him sipped thermos coffee with his Spanish tapes on.
thirty_sec: After the 1994 Northridge earthquake, CNN interviewed drivers stuck on a broken freeway. The first was furious and sure he'd be late. The guy behind him had left at five with coffee, lunch, a book and language tapes, and said it was no problem. Jack Canfield uses it to explain E + R = O: same event, different response, different outcome. He adds a Lexus dealer who, when the Gulf War emptied the showroom, drove the cars to marinas and polo grounds and ended up selling more than before.
